title: A member added to a bare document that follows an end marker and a byte order mark
notes: After `...` a new document may start with a byte order mark (productions 202 and 211); the mark is not content and not indentation. The second document is the mapping `a: |` with the literal `t`, so `add /n` appends `n: 1` at column 0 after the scalar. The first document and the mark are untouched.

provenance.reference: An editor that counted the byte order mark as indentation of the second document and wrote the new member at column 1.
